threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of just 'the transport.' Locals know it's all about the bus routes and night buses here.
Last night on the 36, guy got on with a parrot on his shoulder, chatting like it was normal. Bus driver just shook his head and carried on.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a group of kids using a broken bus stop as a makeshift stage, performing a whole musical. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find a kebab shop doubling as an art gallery, where the skewers come with a side of avant-garde vibes.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they know to avoid Civic Center during a BART meltdown, not just for themselves but for their whole morning commute.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a bus full of tourists stranded while an Muni operator calmly directed them to hop off and take selfies with the Civic Center fountain. Iconic.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists rush to take photos at Plaça Virreina, but they miss the tucked-away cafés where locals truly enjoy their morning coffee.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they still clutch their subway map like a lifeline, staring at it in the middle of a busy Plaça Catalunya.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still refer to the overground as the 'train' instead of the 'DLR' or comfortably mix it up with the tube. Classic rookie mistake.
Last Friday, a guy serenaded the entire bus with a ukulele rendition of Wonderwall. Not even the drivers could keep a straight face.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy fixing his bike in front of the Turkish bakery, while the smell of fresh simit wafted through the air. That’s when it clicked.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you see people dancing at a bus stop during a strike, creating impromptu parties instead of waiting in frustration. It's a vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to avoid the Civic Center BART station when the fog rolls in; it's always a gamble with those delays and random smoke. Try taking the 14 instead.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy serenade waiting passengers with a ukulele on Market St. Muni may be delayed, but the city keeps its vibe alive.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stroll into any bar and get a table after 8 PM. In Gràcia, you might be waiting for a while, especially on weekend evenings.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still ask for a ‘café con leche’ instead of a ‘café amb llet’ and look confused when the waiter doesn’t nod.
